chars.HUSBAND: a slim Moroccan man in his late 20s with short black hair and a neat short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.HAJAR: a beautiful young Moroccan woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a sky-blue long knit cardigan over a white top and beige trousers
chars.MYMOM: a plump Moroccan woman in her late 50s wearing a burgundy djellaba with gold trim and a white headscarf
chars.INLAW: a slender Moroccan woman in her 50s with dyed auburn hair in a tight bun, wearing a long black wool coat, big gold hoop earrings and red lipstick

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of a modest family apartment in Berrechid, Morocco. MYMOM and INLAW stand face to face in the doorway, frozen, staring at each other in shocked tense silence; MYMOM's eyes wide with suspicion, INLAW stiff and uneasy. HUSBAND and HAJAR stand just behind INLAW, confused, looking at both mothers. Comic-awkward dramatic tension, 2D cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan family entrance hall with zellige tiles. MYMOM welcomes the young couple with a big smile, holding a tray with a glass of milk and dates; HUSBAND and HAJAR smiling as they step in. Warm happy atmosphere.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with low sofas. INLAW enters; MYMOM, still holding the tray, suddenly stops smiling and stares at her with a strange suspicious narrowed look. INLAW avoids her eyes, looking away nervously.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A narrow hallway in a Moroccan home. HUSBAND pulls MYMOM aside and whispers to her with a worried questioning face; MYMOM shakes her head and waves her hand as if saying it's nothing, but her face looks troubled.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. HUSBAND sits on the sofa next to his father, an older bald man with a grey moustache in a grey sweater. In the background MYMOM stands at the doorway gesturing and calling HAJAR, who stands up to go to the kitchen.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A small side room of a Moroccan home with a low sofa and a tea table. MYMOM sits down very close beside INLAW, leaning towards her with a serious intense face; INLAW sits stiffly, holding her handbag tightly, uncomfortable.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND hides behind a half-open wooden door in a Moroccan hallway, leaning his ear against the gap to eavesdrop, eyes wide with curiosity and worry. Through the gap two women are faintly visible sitting inside.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Side room of a Moroccan home. MYMOM points her finger at INLAW and interrogates her firmly, eyebrows raised; INLAW looks cornered and shocked, hand on her chest. Dramatic close medium shot of the two women.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Side room of a Moroccan home. MYMOM and INLAW are both crying loudly and shouting, hands raised, tears on their faces; HUSBAND bursts through the doorway behind them with a stunned open-mouthed face, totally confused.
